author: Pallas, 1764
status: 여름철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 전국의 하천과 해안, 하구의 모래섬에서 사는 제비갈매기로, 한국·일본·중국·우수리 등지에서 번식하고 필리핀, 뉴기니섬, 오스트레일리아, 인도차이나, 인도, 스리랑카 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 공중에서 정지비행을 하다가 물로 뛰어들어 물고기를 잡는다. 한 번에 알 2~3개를 낳는다. 겨울에는 이마부터 머리꼭대기까지 희어지고 부리는 검게, 다리는 노란 갈색으로 바뀌며, 꼬리가 짧아져 오목꼬리가 된다.

art.subject: Little Tern (Sternula albifrons), adult in breeding plumage as seen at Korean river mouths and coasts from May to August: white forehead forming a triangle that reaches just above the eye; black crown and nape; a black line from the bill base to the eye joining the cap; pale grey upperparts and wings, the outer two or three primaries blackish, forming a dark leading edge to the wingtip; underparts, rump and forked tail white. Bill yellow with a small black tip; dark eye; legs short, yellowish-orange.
art.pose: hovering over water before plunge-diving for fish
art.scene: Korean river mouth in summer (May–August) with a bare sandbar and shallow water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage (May–August), side view standing on sand: white forehead triangle, black crown and nape, black loral line, pale grey back, yellow bill with black tip, white underparts, short yellowish-orange legs
adult non-breeding plumage (autumn), side view standing: white forehead extending over the forecrown, dark rear crown and nape band, black bill, yellowish-brown legs, shorter notched tail
adult hovering, seen from above: narrow pointed pale grey wings with blackish outer two or three primaries, white rump and short forked white tail
art.build: The smallest tern, about 24cm including the forked tail, much smaller and slighter than Common Tern; slim, narrow-winged, very short-legged. Bill straight, slender and pointed, about as long as the head. At rest the wingtips project a little beyond the tail tip. Tail short and forked, without long streamers. Flight fast with quick, flickering wingbeats; it often hovers on rapidly beating wings before plunge-diving for small fish.
avoid: Do not paint a black forehead; breeding Little Terns have a clear white forehead triangle.
Do not paint a red bill or long tail streamers (Common Tern).
Do not paint black or red legs on breeding birds; they are yellowish-orange.
Do not make it gull-sized or heavy; it is tiny and slender.
